task: Fix totals.total so refunded items are excluded. Preserve integer arithmetic and existing non-refunded behavior. Make the smallest verified change.
acceptance: Empty input returns 0; non-refunded positive and negative amounts are summed; refunded amounts are excluded; missing refunded flag means false.

files.totals.py:
def total(items):
    return sum(item['amount'] for item in items)

verify: python -c "from totals import total; assert total([]) == 0; assert total([{'amount': 10}, {'amount': 4, 'refunded': True}]) == 10"
